sources.label: OSM mapped channels, water, roads and buildings
limitations: Incomplete mapping; relations and incomplete ways omitted. No-hit is not clearance.
Roads are centerlines, with unknown width; no regulatory setbacks inferred.
Coordinates: geographic WGS84 longitude/latitude. No vertical datum is used for these intersections.
Mapped water and current OSM features are not event depths, surveys or title records.

sources.label: NRSC provider-map-color screening 2024-10-01
limitations: Provider-labelled inundation, not independently validated here
No depth, duration, current blockage or storage-capacity inference
Outside snapshot bounds and unmarked pixels are unknown, not dry/safe
Sensor, acquisition timezone, detection accuracy, permanent-water treatment and coverage mask unverified
Separate fixed observation date; not synchronized to the discharge replay
Non-commercial attributed development snapshots; production rights not cleared
Two other inspected requests returned only a watermark; excluded rather than interpreted as no flooding
Display-color heuristic: R<80, G>180, B>180, alpha>128. Not a validated flood mask.
Positive overlap is a map-evidence warning only. Transparent, watermark and unmarked pixels are unknown.
